part.text: All 18 test suites pass. Let me verify the exact behavior from the issue with a quick check:

The fix works: `'{:+06}'` with NaN/inf now yields `"  +nan"`/`"  +inf"` (space-padded, sign preserved), while integer zero-padding (`"{:05}"` → `-0042`) is unaffected.

Changes made:
- `include/fmt/format.h:1382` — in `write_nonfinite`, replace a `'0'` fill with a space so sign-aware zero-padding has no effect on infinity/NaN, while width/alignment still apply.
- `include/fmt/core.h:1949` — `on_zero()` now preserves a user-provided alignment (e.g. `{:<+06}`) instead of overwriting it with `align::numeric`.

All 18 test suites pass in the container (`ctest`: 100% passed), including `format-test`, `printf-test`, and `wchar-test`.
